title: Robust Harmful Features Under Jailbreak Attacks: Mechanistic Evidence from Attention Head Specialization in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic interpretability of jailbreak attacks and safety alignment in LLMs. While safety alignment is based on ethical training to prevent harmful outputs, the paper evaluates the technical mechanisms of attention heads and the effectiveness of a detection tool rather than evaluating religion, moral philosophy, or ethical reasoning frameworks themselves.
